# Vendored

## `cftest.js`

A **verbatim** copy of `js/cftest.js` from
[climbing-coach](https://github.com/rlmck/climbing-coach), at commit
`615b79b`.

It is here so this app files a test in exactly the shape Coach reads,
without a second implementation of the same parse. Coach's rule is that
the load cell's arithmetic is never re-done; writing our own reader here
would re-do it, and the two would drift the first time either changed.

**Do not edit this file.** Change it in Coach, then re-copy:

```bash
cp ../Coach/js/cftest.js vendor/cftest.js
```

It needs `CT.GRIPS` and `CT.dt` in place before it loads, which is what
`js/ct-shim.js` is for.
